title: Granola header
description: A fixed, airy top bar: heavy lowercase wordmark, five quiet centred links, a hairline 'talk to us' pill and a Download pill. Bare at the top of the page; once you scroll it gains a hairline, translucent paper fill and blur (an inset rounded pill on desktop) and the Download pill turns olive. Phones get the wordmark, a 'get the app' pill and a burger menu.
notes: fixed: it floats over the block below, so the next block should leave ~56px at its top
the scrolled look fades in over the first 120px of page scroll (CSS scroll timeline); without support, or with reduced motion, it is always on
the phone menu is a <details> disclosure: no JavaScript
